production_data_from_deploy_log.note: These numbers are from the production VM audit. They represent the GROUND TRUTH for the KXCHINAANNOUNCE event and kalshi_llm_arbitrage performance. They were extracted by the Board (user) via az vm run-command queries run on 2026-05-17.

kalshi_llm_arbitrage_full_window.note: All categories including Climate/Weather and Crypto. After excluding those two categories: 150 trades, 40% WR, -$17.67.

Economics.note: Dominated by US macro release bets (PPI, CPI, airfare). 36 trades on scheduled releases = 0 wins, -$36.

Financials.note: Strict gate added post-audit to require divergence>=30% + LLM in extreme band

kxchinaannounce_26may.event_title: What will Trump announce as part of his China trip?

kalshi_llm_result.note: LLM accidentally captured this structural mispricing. Low-p bias made it bet NO across the board. All 16 wins were NO bets resolving NO. 2 losses: likely the SOYA sub-market which resolved YES.

structure_arb_simulation.note: Simulated from known data. sum_yes_implied=4.6 >> 1.5 threshold, K=7 >= 3. Top-3 by implied_yes at any reasonable fire-time: FENT(0.83), SOYA(0.84-0.89), AISA(0.66-0.80). Exact ranking depends on which observation timestamp is used as fire-time.

top3_picks_scenario_a.note: Using max observed implied_yes per sub-market (upper bound of range)

top3_picks_scenario_b.note: Using single-observation snapshot (e.g. FENT=0.83, SOYA=0.84, AISA=0.52). AISA replaced by USDET or RARE depending on snapshot.

production_data_gaps.kalshi_llm_probability_called_coverage: Only fires for sub-markets passing prob_lo=0.05..prob_hi=0.95 filter AND not on cooldown. Extreme-tail sub-markets (e.g., implied_yes < 0.05 or > 0.95) are missing from the audit log. For KXCHINAANNOUNCE with implied_yes ranging 0.50-0.89, all 7 sub-markets would have been within bounds IF they passed the LLM cooldown and TTR filters.
production_data_gaps.resolver_ordering_bug: Fixed 2026-05-16 16:55 UTC. Before fix, ~605 past-expiration rows were never reached by the resolver (ORDER BY ts ASC starvation). Post-fix kalshi_round_trips count grew from 194 to 245 in 5 min. Resolution coverage improved significantly.
production_data_gaps.activity_collapse_5_14_to_5_15: 155 trades on 5/14 dropped to 8 trades on 5/15. Cause not investigated. May affect event coverage in any time-windowed backtest.
production_data_gaps.1761_pending_unresolved: As of 2026-05-17, kalshi_llm_arbitrage has 1,761 would_have_placed rows not yet paired into round_trips. These represent bets on markets still pending resolution (up to 30-day horizon). They cannot contribute resolution data to this backtest.
